newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed ahead of PPI.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed ahead of PPI.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade with most traders sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. October producer price index and the outcome of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting, dealers said on Wednesday.
The producer price index for October is forecast to be unchanged from September's increase of 0.2 percent.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on lack of fresh incentives. Some people are waiting for today's PPI figures and the outcome of the FOMC meeting for more clues to market direction," a local dealer said.
"But unless the numbers are way off market expectations, I don't think there will be much impact," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Wednesday/Thursday, Thursday/Friday and week-fixed were unchanged from Tuesday's common 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, respectively.
Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8, six-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent.
